title: Theo and the Ledger
author: Wren Galloway
blurb: Beatrix Sandoval, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
